pages.text: Welcome to $(#f80051)TerraFirmaNautics$()! A modpack centered around $(l:https://terrafirmacraft.github.io/Field-Guide/en_us/)TerraFirmaCraft$() and $(l:https://createsimulated.com/)Create Aeronautics$(). $(br) This pack's aim is to bring both mods together and create a seamless experience for the player, from surviving TFC's early game to building a giant paper clip factory spanning the entire galaxy, the world is $(bold)yours$() to automate.
The only limit is your imagination... And the laws of physics.
